method: 10 and 20 isolated actual Chrome contexts with CDP virtual focus making real document.visibilityState visible; API RTT 75ms; product timers unchanged; >=65 seconds steady per cohort

baselineUserProvided.note: User-provided aggregate; D1 queries are not Worker HTTP requests. No observed increase may be equated directly with this query count.

limits: No operating API requests or production D1 operations.
CDP visibility emulation isolates simultaneous foreground behavior; this is not a measured fleet of physical devices.
Native app launch and physical GPS remain mocked.
Measured Worker endpoint requests need actual per-endpoint D1 SQL metrics before calculating D1 row-read cost.
Continuous hour/day figures extrapolate 65 seconds, exclude ten-minute refresh boundary and user interactions; they are scenarios, not observed traffic.

normalizationContract.initial: For each client, firstAPIAt <= request.at < firstAPIAt+2000 ms.
normalizationContract.steady: For each client, max(original65sStart,firstAPIAt+2000) <= request.at <= original65sEnd. These sets are disjoint; no request is exactly at the cutoff in these observations.
normalizationContract.unmodifiedOriginal: LOAD_MANIFEST_RAW.json and cohort-10.json/cohort-20.json preserve original phase labels, request timestamps, 65s windows and all 18 safety assertions.
normalizationContract.why: Bootstrap-ready did not mean every parallel postflight HEAD was complete. Startup HEADs appearing in the65s phase are kept in raw records and classified by their original timestamps; no product code or assertion changed.
normalizationContract.rate: Counts divided by the sum of actual per-client normalized exposure milliseconds. Individual exposures exceed63s and are not replaced with a60s/65s denominator.
normalizationContract.total: 10 users:130 initial+570 steady=113 raw-bootstrap+13 waiting+574 raw-steady=700.20 users:260 initial+1140 steady=220 raw-bootstrap+34 waiting+1146 raw-steady=1400.

safetyScope: 18 unchanged cohort-level assertions:9 each for10/20 users, each requiring all involved clients. The241 independent Chrome suite separately covers clock rollback/delayed GPS/aux-context routing. Load observations cover lease expiration, hide/delete, actual hidden document, network failure and recovery.250ms samples do not prove zero-ms revocation.
